data.rationale: The proposal gets the GitHub lookup and the To/Subject/Body email right, but it omits the blog tab step, so there is no {blog} parameter. It also adds an unsupported "Users" filter step, ends with Send where the true workflow clicks Discard, and lists outputs like followers and stars as parameters, so it couldn't be automated as written.
